summary: Secret values are replaced with salted digests before any row, snapshot, journal image or FTS entry is stored, existing rows are rewritten by schema migration 15, and a body holding a placeholder is refused before it is sent.
reason: User decision after review: sql and search returned WiFi passphrases, and snapshots kept 60 generations of them. The generator has no per-field storage hook, so the seam is in the generated upsert entry points.
validated_outcome: TestSyncedSecretsNeverReachDisk, TestMigrationSealsExistingSecrets and TestSQLAndSearchNeverReturnSyncedSecrets, against httptest only. Whether a live console returns these fields is unverified.
